manualReview.scope: Model/editor text and pedagogy pass for the owner-authorized Lessons 0014–0020 extension; not an independent human review.

englishNaturalness.evidence: 'What day?', 'On Monday.', and 'Monday or Tuesday?' are concise and natural in a known event-planning context.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Checked every Persian title, instruction, turn translation, prompt and option explanation against the intended English meaning; wording stays simple and avoids forbidden Arabic orthographic forms.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Day vocabulary follows the prior time Lesson and keeps the planning task limited to two weekdays.

distractorQuality.evidence: Choices separate day answers from a known clock-time answer, forcing the learner to distinguish day from time.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Liam and Leo continue the library program story by scheduling the next session rather than repeating the refreshment episode.

difficultyFit.evidence: Monday and Tuesday are introduced with the already familiar or pattern and a single on + day frame.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Guided practice uses Monday; hidden retrieval changes to Tuesday.

transferQuality.evidence: The prior time-question pattern is extended from time of day to day of week while preserving a clear scheduling context.

overallCoherence.evidence: The Lesson has one job: understand and state the day of a simple event.

learnerExperience.evidence: Static content-flow review only: prompts, explicit help and per-option feedback reduce dead ends, but no real learner, microphone, timing or perception test has been performed.

limitations: Real learner outcomes and delayed retention have not been measured.
Generated audio has not received a perceptual or prosody review.
Exact-match retrieval recognizes bounded patterns; valid alternative English can fall outside its answer list.
